summary: OpenAI announced price cuts for GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra API pricing and introduced a faster "Fast mode" option for GPT-5.6 Sol at double the price.

practices.reason: A new Fast mode option trades higher price for lower latency at the same output quality, worth evaluating for latency-sensitive workloads.
practices.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol gets Fast mode in the API, up to 2.5x the speed for 2x the price, same intelligence
